title: Settling a Workmanship Share with Adjustment Credit — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
## Settling a workmanship share with an adjustment credit — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty

A share settlement applies the treadwear adjustment credit of a Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty set toward the tire part of a workmanship share charged on the same set, when the credit must also meet the replacement ticket written for the adjusted tire. The settlement is booked as a credit-applied entry on the set naming the wheel position of the workmanship replacement it settles.

The credit settled on a workmanship share is not fixed until the set carries a treadwear adjustment entry for every position that the latest inspection of the set measured at or below the line's wear-out depth without a recorded defect.

Put the other way: until every position the set's latest inspection measured at or below the line's wear-out depth without a recorded defect carries a treadwear adjustment entry on the set, the credit settled on a workmanship share is not yet a fixed figure.

### Capability
With `apply_credit_to_workmanship_share_57ed5afc` the customer applies part or all of a treadwear adjustment credit of their tire set toward the share they owe on a workmanship replacement made on the same set. One call books one credit-applied entry on the set, citing the adjustment that issued the credit and naming the wheel position of the workmanship replacement it settles; the amount is taken off the adjustment credit available on the set. Once booked, the set shows the lower credit balance and the history shows the entry against that position.

### Invocation
This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `apply_credit_to_workmanship_share_57ed5afc` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

### Parameters
- `tire_set_id` — reference number of the tire set that holds the credit, as returned by the tire set lookup (id).
- `source_tire_event_id` — reference number of the treadwear adjustment entry that issued the credit, as returned by the tire activity history lookup (id).
- `tire_position` — wheel position of the workmanship replacement whose share is settled; enum `LF` left front, `RF` right front, `LR` left rear, `RR` right rear, `SP` a matching full-size spare that is part of the set; `ALL` is never a workmanship position and applies only to whole-set services.
- `amount` — credit applied toward the workmanship share, in USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent.

### Return
A receipt with `tire_event_id` (reference number of the credit-applied entry), `tire_set_id`, `tire_position`, `amount` (USD applied) and `adjustment_credit_balance` (USD credit still available on the set). A returned `tire_event_id` means the credit was applied.
